hooks.command: for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/kontor"; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/guard.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/.claude/hooks/guard.py"; fi; done; exit 0
for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/kontor"; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/briefing.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/.claude/hooks/briefing.py" hook; fi; done; exit 0

for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/kontor"; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/tools/setup.sh" ]; then (nohup bash "$d/.claude/tools/setup.sh" >/tmp/kontor-setup.out 2>&1 &); exit 0; fi; done; exit 0
for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/kontor"; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/briefing.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/.claude/hooks/briefing.py" hook; fi; done; exit 0
for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/kontor"; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/finish_check.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/.claude/hooks/finish_check.py"; fi; done; exit 0
